status: Design proposals; no runtime implementation or playtest evidence.
rarity_policy: Direct Common/Uncommon/Rare source tiers retained. Shop/Event origins remain source_rarity and acquisition categories, with proposed power tiers.

upgrades.name: Ballistic Starter
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Akabeko's Uncommon source tier.
upgrades.effect: At fight start, queue +6 damage for the first valid main shot this fight. Spend it only on Fire; it survives zero-shot turns and never affects support hits.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Large opening burst against weak robots.

upgrades.name: Bounty Transponder
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Amethyst Aubergine's Common source tier.
upgrades.effect: After victory with at least one robot killed, gain 8 Credits. One payment per fight, independent of robot count.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Credit value depends on shop prices.

upgrades.name: Opening Relay
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Anchor's Common source tier.
upgrades.effect: At the first player-turn start of every fight, grant 6 active Shield. It protects during preparation and the enemy phase, then follows the normal enemy-turn-end reset.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Fight-start grant cannot retrigger on screen reopen.

upgrades.name: Foldout Safety Rail
upgrades.rarity_basis: Event is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Common is proposed for this adaptation's defence fallback benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: At the first End Turn of each fight, if no Shield parts are installed, auto-install one ordinary 4-Shield part. It follows normal depletion and reset.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Only one eligibility check per fight.

upgrades.name: Idle Furnace Turbine
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Art of War's Rare source tier.
upgrades.effect: At End Turn, if no Fire occurred this turn, schedule 2 Iron and 1 Carbon for next player-turn start. One grant per qualifying turn; pending grants expire at fight end.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: May reward overlong defensive stalling.

upgrades.name: Rangefinder Beacon
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Bag of Marbles's Common source tier.
upgrades.effect: At fight start, apply Target Paint 2 to the living robot with highest maximum HP; break ties by encounter slot order.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Opening debuffs combine with Ivo.

upgrades.name: Ready Rack
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Bag of Preparation's Common source tier.
upgrades.effect: At fight start, grant one fresh SH001 Plain Slug and one SH003 Powder Cap to reserve, at their normal recipe values. Owning those recipes is unnecessary.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Finite free parts have normal resale value.

upgrades.name: Impact Governor
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Beating Remnant's Rare source tier.
upgrades.effect: Limit total enemy-caused HP loss to 18 per round. Count actual loss after Shield from attacks, recoil and damage statuses; prevent loss beyond the allowance. Reset at player-turn start. Player-paid HP costs are excluded. A hit can still kill before reaching the allowance.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Strong against large multi-hit turns.

upgrades.name: Cold Start Calibrator
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Bellows's Rare source tier.
upgrades.effect: On the first player turn each fight, the first three resource-paid part-producing Uses each add 2 to the first output's direct damage or Shield. Choose one value the part has; outputs with neither spend no trigger. Copies are not production.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Three payouts total, not three per recipe.

upgrades.name: Bare-Bay Reinforcer
upgrades.rarity_basis: Shop is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Uncommon is proposed for this adaptation's empty reserve build benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: At End Turn, if no ordinary parts remain in reserve, auto-install one ordinary 5-Shield part. Installed parts do not count as reserve. Once per turn.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: May cause unnecessary assembly shuffling.

upgrades.name: Dense Chassis Retrofit
upgrades.rarity_basis: Event is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Uncommon is proposed for this adaptation's durability tradeoff benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: On acquisition, gain 18 maximum HP and heal 18 HP. Each fight's first base haul delivers 2 fewer material units, minimum zero; steering and Precision bonuses stay intact.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Opening shortage needs visible preview.

upgrades.name: Blueprint Twin Writer
upgrades.rarity_basis: Event is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Rare is proposed for this adaptation's recipe duplication benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: After the first accepted recipe reward from each victory, optionally store one additional exact copy. It uses a normal memory slot and permits an exchange if full. This generated extra cannot trigger the item again.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: No trigger from shops or generated copies.

upgrades.name: Microrepair Reservoir
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Blood Vial's Common source tier.
upgrades.effect: At fight start, heal 2 HP, capped by maximum HP. Restarting the same fight restores its original entry state before this single grant.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Never heal repeatedly by save reload.

upgrades.name: Emergency Sealant Patch
upgrades.rarity_basis: Event is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Common is proposed for this adaptation's delayed recovery benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: Once per fight, the first enemy hit causing HP loss schedules a 3 HP heal at next player-turn start, only if the player survives. Player HP costs do not qualify.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Cannot prevent death or revive.

upgrades.name: Trial Fabricator License
upgrades.rarity_basis: Event is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Uncommon is proposed for this adaptation's limited duplication benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: For the next three fights after acquisition, the first resource-paid Ammo Use each fight also copies its first physical output. Copy that part's committed properties without replaying on-Use or scheduled-delivery effects. Keep the spent license visible afterwards.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Copies must not repeat recipe activation effects.

upgrades.name: Curriculum Medchip
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Book of Five Rings's Common source tier.
upgrades.effect: After every fifth recipe accepted from victory rewards since acquisition, heal 8 HP. Counter persists across cities; shop purchases and generated extra copies do not count.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Count acceptance, not viewing or replacing.

upgrades.name: Salvage Contract Stamp
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Bowler Hat's Uncommon source tier.
upgrades.effect: Increase Credits from victory rewards by 25%, flooring the added amount once per reward screen. Core sales, part sales and other upgrades' direct Credit grants are unaffected.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Not a sale-price multiplier.

upgrades.name: Delayed Power Coupler
upgrades.rarity_basis: Shop is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Uncommon is proposed for this adaptation's slow engine benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: Reduce the first turn's base haul by 2 material units, minimum zero. At player-turn starts 2 onward, grant 1 Copper before the ordinary haul. Steering and Precision bonuses are unchanged.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Long-fight efficiency may dominate.

upgrades.name: Counterpulse Studs
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Bronze Scales's Common source tier.
upgrades.effect: After an enemy attack hit removes at least 1 Shield or HP, deal 2 direct damage to its living attacker. This is an upgrade reaction, not Fire or a support hit; it cannot trigger itself. Enemy damage reactions still apply.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Must stop recursive causal chains without disabling other reactions.

upgrades.name: Utility Recall Buffer
upgrades.rarity_basis: Shop is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Rare is proposed for this adaptation's utility reuse benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: Once per fight, after using a no-cooldown Utility recipe, restore one use of that same copy this turn. Every subsequent Use still pays full costs. This restoration cannot restore itself.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Explicit exception to no-cooldown use allowance.

upgrades.name: Survey Kite
upgrades.rarity_basis: Event is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Uncommon is proposed for this adaptation's chosen opener benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: At fight start, select a robot. The first valid main shot targeting it gains +4 damage. If it dies earlier, the bonus expires. The kite adds no helper commands, HP or interception.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Target marker must look different from Target Paint.

upgrades.name: Second Cycle Feeder
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Candelabra's Uncommon source tier.
upgrades.effect: At player-turn start 2 of each fight, grant 2 Iron and 1 Copper before the haul. No grant if the fight ended earlier.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Delayed supply cannot cross fights.

upgrades.name: Third Cycle Bulwark
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Captain's Wheel's Rare source tier.
upgrades.effect: At player-turn start 3 of each fight, auto-install one ordinary 14-Shield part. It can be removed and saved normally.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Strong against known windups.

upgrades.name: Packed Field Supplies
upgrades.rarity_basis: Shop is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Uncommon is proposed for this adaptation's limited flexible supply benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: On acquisition gain five supply charges. At each of the next five fight starts, spend one charge and choose 2 Iron, 2 Copper or 2 Carbon before the haul. Keep the item visible when spent.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Five campaign charges, not refillable consumables.

upgrades.name: Damage Diagnostic Cache
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Centennial Puzzle's Common source tier.
upgrades.effect: Once per fight after the first enemy-caused HP loss, grant 1 Iron and 1 Copper if the player survives. Enemy-phase grants remain available next turn. HP costs do not qualify.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Cannot revive or refund HP costs.

upgrades.name: Third Cycle Injector
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Chandelier's Rare source tier.
upgrades.effect: At player-turn start 3 of each fight, grant 2 Copper and 2 Carbon before the haul.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Turn3 spike needs encounter testing.

upgrades.name: Batch Expansion Socket
upgrades.rarity_basis: Shop is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Rare is proposed for this adaptation's batch production benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: Once per turn, a resource-paid recipe producing at least two ordinary parts also copies its first physical output. Do not replay on-Use effects or scheduled deliveries.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Free output has ordinary resale; finite trigger.

upgrades.name: Reserve Resonator
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Cloak Clasp's Rare source tier.
upgrades.effect: At End Turn, auto-install one ordinary Shield part worth 1 Shield per ordinary part in reserve, capped at 7. Grant nothing at zero. Installed parts do not count. Once per turn.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Seven caps the payout, never inventory size.
upgrades.source_fact: Turn end:1 Block per card remaining in hand.

upgrades.name: Hazard Compensation Chip
upgrades.rarity_basis: Event is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Rare is proposed for this adaptation's compensated disruption benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: The first enemy application of each new debuff type to the player in a fight grants 1 maximum HP and heals 1 HP, up to three gains per fight. Extra stacks of a present type and self-applied penalties do not qualify.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Debuff identity and new application require clear tracking.

upgrades.name: Recoil Harness
upgrades.rarity_basis: Event is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Uncommon is proposed for this adaptation's multi-shot defence benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: After each of the first three Fires per player turn, auto-install one ordinary 2-Shield part. Support hits are not Fires; later Fires remain allowed.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Local payout limit prevents unlimited grants.

upgrades.name: Open Standard Decoder
upgrades.rarity_basis: Shop is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Uncommon is proposed for this adaptation's recipe choice benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: Each normal victory recipe offer gains a fourth option from the shared recipe pool, using its current rarity tier. You may still select only one recipe. Officer bonus offers are unchanged.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Fourth option needs duplicate filtering.

upgrades.name: Recipe Carbon Copier
upgrades.rarity_basis: Shop is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Uncommon is proposed for this adaptation's duplicate key recipe benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: On acquisition choose one stored recipe and add one exact ready copy. It needs a memory slot; exchange a different stored copy or decline if full. The upgrade remains owned either way.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Specific copy identity matters for other enhancements.

upgrades.name: Dividend Biolattice
upgrades.rarity_basis: Shop is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Rare is proposed for this adaptation's economy into survival benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: After the first core sale following each victory, gain 1 maximum HP and heal 1 HP. Each victory creates at most one entitlement; further individual sales cannot repeat it. Part sales do not qualify.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Prevent split-sale growth farming.

upgrades.name: Repair Manual Receiver
upgrades.rarity_basis: Event is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Uncommon is proposed for this adaptation's periodic reward choice benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: After every third victory since acquisition, add one shared Utility option to that fight's normal recipe reward. Keep one pick total. The counter carries between cities.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: No rest-site system needed.

upgrades.name: Temporary Overclock Firmware
upgrades.rarity_basis: Event is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Uncommon is proposed for this adaptation's limited offensive lease benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: For the next five fights, the first two valid main shots each fight gain +3 damage. Mark the item spent after the fifth fight; escape-only completion also consumes a fight charge.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Bonus expires with its fight if unused.

upgrades.name: Archive Recovery Index
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Eternal Feather's Uncommon source tier.
upgrades.effect: After victory heal 1 HP per complete five stored recipe copies, up to 4 HP. Read memory before rewards. No healing after an escape-only fight or player defeat.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Extra capacity helps only up to this item's payout cap.
upgrades.source_fact: Rest-site entry:heal3 for each complete group of5 deck cards.

upgrades.name: Arrival Flare
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Festive Popper's Common source tier.
upgrades.effect: After robot fight-opening setup, deal 4 direct damage to every living robot. This upgrade attack is not Fire; enemy damage reactions still apply and can harm the player.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Opening recoil can be lethal; stop resolution on death.

upgrades.name: Sacrifice Inductor
upgrades.rarity_basis: Event is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Uncommon is proposed for this adaptation's sacrifice payoff benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: The first two explicit ordinary-part sacrifice events each player turn deal 3 direct damage to the living robot in the lowest occupied encounter slot. Firing, Shield depletion and sales are not sacrifices.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Count events, not copied secondary effects.

upgrades.name: Risky Calibration Kit
upgrades.rarity_basis: Event is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Rare is proposed for this adaptation's permanent recipe tuning benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: On acquisition pay 8 HP, requiring at least 9, and choose one Ammo recipe copy and one Shield recipe copy in memory. Their first output gains +2 direct damage or +2 Shield respectively on each paid Use. Offer only if both types are stored.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Enhancement stays with those copies and is lost if removed.

upgrades.name: Shield Specification Scanner
upgrades.rarity_basis: Event is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Rare is proposed for this adaptation's reward-grown defence benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: The first Shield recipe accepted from each victory reward becomes Reinforced: its first output gains +2 Shield on every resource-paid Use. One tag per physical recipe copy; generated duplicates are not new qualifying acceptances.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Track copy enhancements separately from recipe definition.

upgrades.name: Utility Bench Compiler
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Frozen Egg's Rare source tier.
upgrades.effect: Each new Utility recipe copy accepted from victory rewards gets a startup coupon: its first Copper-consuming Use each fight costs 1 less Copper. Other costs remain full. Applies only to copies accepted after acquisition.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Not a discount on all repeat Uses.

upgrades.name: Haul Sorter
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Gambling Chip's Rare source tier.
upgrades.effect: After the first ordinary haul each fight, exchange up to three of its base-material units for the same number of different standard-material units of your choice. No exchange of steering or Precision bonuses. Confirm once.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: No repeated reroll or increased haul size.

upgrades.name: Utility Assembly Shuttle
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Game Piece's Rare source tier.
upgrades.effect: Once per turn, after the third resource-paid Utility Use that turn, grant one fresh SH003 Powder Cap. Reused cooled copies count; free Uses and copied effects do not.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Full third Use costs precede grant.

upgrades.name: Starter Scrap Reclaimer
upgrades.rarity_basis: Shop is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Uncommon is proposed for this adaptation's starter economy benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: Once per turn after firing a bullet containing an SH001 Plain Slug, return 1 Iron. The slug is consumed normally; selling, sacrificing or loading alone do not qualify.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: One refund prevents a self-funding slug loop.

upgrades.name: Training Gyroscope
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Girya's Rare source tier.
upgrades.effect: Each Officer victory after acquisition grants one calibration level, capped at 3. At fight start queue twice that level as bonus damage for the first valid main shot. No retroactive levels.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Slow acquisition payoff must stay visible.

upgrades.name: Precision Die Set
upgrades.rarity_basis: Shop is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Uncommon is proposed for this adaptation's recipe specialization benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: On acquisition select up to three Ammo recipe copies. Each chosen copy adds 1 direct damage to its first physical output on every paid Use. No effect on outputs without direct damage or later-generated recipe copies.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Persistent copy identity needed.

upgrades.name: Layered Undersuit
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Gorget's Common source tier.
upgrades.effect: At End Turn on player turns 1 and 2 each fight, auto-install an ordinary 3-Shield part. Each named turn grants once; protection and reset stay normal.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Separate fresh parts, never Shield retention.

upgrades.name: Kill Recovery Servo
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Gremlin Horn's Uncommon source tier.
upgrades.effect: After the first robot killed during each player turn, grant 1 Iron and 1 Carbon if the player survives. Summoned robots qualify; later kills that turn grant nothing.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Local allowance limits summon farming.

upgrades.name: Armor Breach Probe
upgrades.rarity_basis: Event is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Uncommon is proposed for this adaptation's break then follow up benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: Once per player turn, after a player hit whose damage was actually reduced by a robot's Armor, apply Target Paint 2 to that surviving robot. The triggering hit receives no retroactive benefit. Hits reduced only by other effects do not qualify.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Adapted to the current roster: Armor mitigation exists, while enemy Shield does not. Require an actual reduction and a surviving target.

upgrades.name: Three-Cycle Hopper
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Happy Flower's Common source tier.
upgrades.effect: At player-turn starts 3, 6, 9 and so on, grant 1 Iron and 1 Copper before the haul. Reset the cycle each fight.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Long fights may enable stockpiling, which remains allowed.

upgrades.name: Five-Cycle Recycler
upgrades.rarity_basis: Event is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Common is proposed for this adaptation's slow steered supply benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: After the ordinary haul resolves on player turns 5, 10, 15 and so on, gain 1 additional unit of that haul's steered material. Reset the counter each fight. This grants a bonus material, not an extra haul.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Small delayed payoff should not be a trap reward.

upgrades.name: Last Shot Recorder
upgrades.rarity_basis: Event is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Rare is proposed for this adaptation's alternating heavy shots benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: At player-turn start, if a main shot fired last turn, queue bonus damage for the next main shot equal to one quarter of that last shot's damage before enemy mitigation, rounded down, capped at 8. Do not copy parts, statuses, support hits or other effects. Unused queued damage expires at End Turn.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Echo reads pre-mitigation final main damage only; capped to prevent self-escalation.
upgrades.source_fact: Turn opening:copy last Attack or Skill.

upgrades.name: Second Cycle Shutter
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Horn Cleat's Uncommon source tier.
upgrades.effect: At player-turn start 2 each fight, auto-install one ordinary 10-Shield part. It remains removable and saveable before protection is used.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Compare with early burst versus late defence.

upgrades.name: Interfight Freight Seal
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Ice Cream's Rare source tier.

upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Explicit exception to fight-end material clearing; pending cargo must save deterministically.

upgrades.name: Heavy Press Brace
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Intimidating Helmet's Rare source tier.
upgrades.effect: The first two recipe Uses each turn that actually pay at least 5 material units each auto-install one ordinary 3-Shield part after resolving. HP, Heat and Charge do not count as materials.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Discounts alter qualification because actual payment counts.

upgrades.name: Scrap Cycle Counter
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Joss Paper's Uncommon source tier.
upgrades.effect: After every third explicit ordinary-part sacrifice in a fight, grant 1 Glass. Count individual sacrificed parts, not firing, sales or Shield depletion. Reset the counter each fight.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: A recipe sacrificing several parts advances several counts once each.

upgrades.name: Safe Signal Survey
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Juzu Bracelet's Common source tier.
upgrades.effect: During route generation after acquisition, replace a Mystery outcome that would secretly become a Regular fight with a noncombat Mystery outcome from that city's eligible pool. Officer, boss and visibly offered fights are unchanged.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Needs authored noncombat replacement outcomes; no retrospective route rewrite.

upgrades.name: Claw Dwell Stabilizer
upgrades.rarity_basis: Shop is the source acquisition category, not a power tier. Uncommon is proposed for this adaptation's claw reliability benefit; values remain untested.
upgrades.effect: Widen the successful region of the optional Precision timing marker by 20% of its original width, centered on the same point and clamped to the marker track. Attempts and material payout stay unchanged.
upgrades.default_exception: Only the specific grant, modifier or override stated in this effect applies; all other base rules remain in force.
upgrades.balance_risk: Measures timing width, never fractional damage; success rate requires testing.
upgrades.source_fact: Pickup:up to three cards gain Adroit.

upgrades.name: Defensive Rhythm Servo
upgrades.rarity_basis: Matches Kunai's Rare source tier.
upgrades.effect: Once each player turn after the third Fire, gain one brace level for the fight. Every later resource-paid Shield recipe's first physical output gains Shield equal to brace level, capped at +4. The triggering turn's future production qualifies.
